title: Circular Nearest Neighbors
statement:
Use monotonic stacks to find the nearest strictly greater or smaller value in either direction around a circular array. Stop after n−1 steps.

Input
n q, then n integers and q lines type i with 1 ≤ i ≤ n. Types 1, 2, 3, 4 mean next greater, next smaller, previous greater, previous smaller. Moving next after n reaches 1, and moving previous from 1 reaches n.

Output
Print the distance in steps, or 0 if no index qualifies.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Array values have absolute value at most 10⁹. 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000.
